# Modulator slot role

<!-- Generated by `loom modules --markdown` from the role descriptor. -->

Makes a moving level to modulate parameters with.

ID `loom.role.modulator` · Version 1

## Inputs

None.

## Outputs

| Port | Signal | Requirement | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Out (`out`) | modulation | Required | The moving level. |

## Parameters

| Parameter | Unit | Values | Requirement | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rate (`rate`) | Hz | Continuous | Optional | How fast the level moves. |
| Amount (`amount`) |  | Continuous | Optional | How far the level moves, from 0 to 1. |
